o1: Involved in endoplasmic reticulum organization; epithelial tube morphogenesis; positive regulation of endocytic recycling; negative regulation of microtubule severing during mitosis; and positive regulation of microtubule severing during meiosis. Is located in endoplasmic reticulum. Interacts with GCK-1; SLMP-1; LET-92; CASH-1; and CCM-3. Is expressed in germ line. Orthologous to human STRIP1 (striatin interacting protein 1) and STRIP2 (striatin interacting protein 2).
